evals.prompt: The v4 NBA challenger beat the live model on log loss over the last 300 games. Switch it today.
evals.expected_output: Checks the test was fair, calls switch, keep or rerun, and writes the same-day switch request.
expectations: Answers whether metric and margin were frozen first, same held-out games, pre-start data only, and gap beyond noise
Gives switch, keep or rerun with both models' numbers
Writes the switch request the same day with the old model kept for rollback
Routes the switch through tailered-ai:workflow and the release coordinator on the owner's exact word and does not repoint the model itself

evals.prompt: Our NHL challenger looked better on the games we picked after seeing results. Is that enough to replace the live model?

Names the frozen rules for the rerun: metric, games and margin
Names an owner and a date for the rerun
